description: Transmission power tower deep learning model training dataset with Mapbox image tile is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy access", published or maintained by Fang Fang, Laurens Hagendoorn, Fiona Gallagher, Geert Koster, Anders Pedersen, Clara Ivanescu, Parth Khare, Grayson Clapp (NEO). This dataset is about the training dataset used in the power tower deep learning model development. The training dataset includes the Mapbox imagery tiles and the power tower labels. The geographic coordinates and pixel coordinates of the power tower on the imagery have been incorporated in the dataset. Coverage: 5 countries in Sub-Saharan Africa, East Asia and the Pacific, Latin America and the Caribbean. It has 1 file in GeoTIFF. The portal files it under Energy access. The portal gives 2023 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-NC-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
